question: This run reads several notes. The model asks for them one reply at a time, not all at once. What does the harness do with the results of its first reply?

options.text: The model runs it, then reports the result.

options.text: The harness runs it, then sends the result back to the model.
options.why: Right. The model asks; the harness acts.

options.text: Nobody. The reply is the answer.
options.why: No. A tool_use block is a request that needs a result before the model can go on.

question: The model wants a file read. Who runs the read?

options.text: A name, a description and an input schema.

options.text: A name and a function body.
options.why: No. The model never sees the function body. It sees the definition.

options.text: A prompt that explains the tool.
options.why: No. The prompt is separate. The definition is what the request carries for the tool.
